text:
alyssa: Heads-up — FieldSec sent a packed security questionnaire for our on‑prem offering. Key asks: KMS proof, RBAC change history (90d), audit log samples, vuln status, and IR runbook. starting thread to collect artifacts

jordan: drop the pdf/link?

alyssa: link: https://drive.internal/fieldsec-q2 (shared). Highlights from Q: 1) key provenance & HSM attestation, 2) key unwrap/access logs, 3) RBAC modifications and who approved, 4) incident response steps for key compromise, 5) patch status for listed CVEs.

mike: We can produce an "envelope proof" for onprem agent + HSM attestation summary. Need to redact tenant IDs before sharing. Also can pull audit-chain samples showing unwrap events.

sarah: We should assemble a minimal evidence bundle: signed manifest, redacted audit logs (sha256 hashes), RBAC export (redact emails), SIEM correlation example. Keep it small — they only want representative artifacts.

sec-bot: vuln-triage update: CVE-2025-1234 (libcrypto) -> fixed in 2.1.3. Dedicated and hosted are updated; onprem customers require scheduled patch window. Mitigation: disable legacy ciphers + WAF rule.

jordan: @mike please run RBAC export using the helper:

```
./scripts/export_rbac.sh --since 90d --redact email --out rbac-export-fieldsec.json
```

mike: on it. note: full keystore proofs require explicit customer consent. propose we provide an HSM attestation summary + signed key metadata instead of raw key material. @alyssa want legal note wording?

alyssa: yes I'll loop in legal for a DPA addendum request. meanwhile prep redacted logs + attestations. ensure rotation events are present in the audit sample.

sarah: IR runbook excerpt to include in answers:
1) Containment: isolate affected node(s), take forensic snapshot.
2) Eradication: rotate affected keys and revoke derived tokens.
3) Recovery: restore from validated snapshots, re‑apply minimal config.
4) Notification: inform customer & SOC, open incident ticket.

For snapshot example:

```sh
# pv: snapshot kv cache from inference pod
kubectl -n inference exec -it inference-0 -- tar cvf /tmp/kvcache.tar /var/lib/kv && kubectl cp inference/inference-0:/tmp/kvcache.tar ./kvcache-fieldsec.tar
```

mike: uploaded preliminary artifacts to internal share: /evidence/fieldsec/2026-03-20 (zipped + signed). redacted per PII policy. added manifest with sha256 entries and cosign signature note.

alyssa: can someone cover the security review call tomorrow 10:00am PT? need a tech + security lead. @jordan @sarah

jordan: I can take the tech portion.

sarah: I can join for sec lead.

mike: I'll be on for any infra questions.

alyssa: perfect. I'll draft the questionnaire answers and attach the evidence bundle. tagging this thread final prep. :thumbsup:

mike: quick followup — we found one dependent package with an outstanding advisory (low sev). created ticket INFSEC-4821 and scheduled patch window 03/27. documenting in reply to Q.

alyssa: noted. include mitigation steps in the response (WAF rule, firewall ACLs, no external exposure). closing here unless new asks come in.
